explanation: The requested kinematic point (W=1.54 GeV, Q²=1.3207 GeV², cos θ*=0.341379, φ*=36°) is physically unphysical. At W=1.54 GeV, which is only 3.62% above the η-production threshold (1.486 GeV), the maximum allowed momentum transfer is Q²_max ≈ 0.088 GeV². The requested Q²=1.3207 GeV² exceeds this limit by a factor of 15, making exclusive production kinematically forbidden. EXCLURAD produced NaN values confirming the point cannot be computed. A physically allowed point requires either: (1) lower Q² at this W (Q² ≤ 0.088 GeV²), or (2) higher W with correspondingly larger Q² allowed (e.g., W ≥ 1.70 GeV allows Q² up to ~1.2 GeV²).
